Logic & Ableton · DAW integration

Export a bank as WAV slices and a matching MIDI map for your DAW. The Mac AU/VST3 source package is available below; it requires building on macOS. This browser does not receive DAW host transport directly. Use internal tempo or a MIDI clock input here.

Keyboard: ⌘S save · ⌘Z undo · ⇧⌘Z redo · Space stop. MIDI: notes 36–51 cue pads, note 48 original pitch in keyboard mode, CC7 master level, CC123 panic, program 0–3 bank.
